# shuang

Install:

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/rasuvaeff/shuang
# or
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rasuvaeff/shuang/master/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

## Rules

- Fail-closed: unknown IP (no quorum) is never allowed.
- The whole process tree is frozen (`SIGSTOP`), not just the root pid.
- The config file is never rewritten: `shuang allow` writes `state.toml`.
- No network traffic except the configured IP checks.

## API

```
shuang check [--json] [--config PATH]     # exit 0 allowed, 3 not allowed, 1 error
shuang allow <ip|cidr|CC> [--config PATH] # append to state.toml
shuang run [--config PATH] -- <cmd...>    # exit 69 bad IP at start, 75 stopped mid-run
shuang daemon [--config PATH]             # watch configured apps
```

`check --json` shape (public contract, additive only):

```json
{"ipv4": "203.0.113.7", "ipv6": null, "country": "NL", "quorum": true, "allowed": true}
```

Config (`~/.config/shuang/config.toml`, all keys optional):

```toml
[[apps]]
name = "claude-code"
match = ["claude", "args:claude", "/MyApp.app/"]

[allow]
ips = ["203.0.113.42"]
nets = ["185.12.40.0/24"]
countries = ["NL"]

[ip_check]
ip_services = [...]      # default: ipify, icanhazip, ident.me, checkip.amazonaws.com
ipv6_services = [...]
country_services = ["https://api.country.is"]
min_agree = 2
interval_secs = 5
timeout_secs = 5

[timing]
grace_secs = 20
close_secs = 5
```

Empty allowlist + `run` = the startup IP is allowed (freeze on change).
